concerns.text: T003's verification condition states 'the documented command in quickstart.md executes end-to-end', but quickstart.md is only produced in T018 (Phase 3). This is a consumer-before-producer dependency: T003 cannot be verified as written until a Phase 3 task completes. Either move a minimal quickstart/command-doc task before T003, or restate T003's verification to reference the command inline (e.g. 'the command `python code/main.py --variant student-only --env alfworld --seed 0` executes end-to-end').

T005's verification runs `ruff check code/` using the new pyproject.toml config, but `ruff` is not in T004's dependency list (requirements.txt contains transformers, datasets, ..., but no ruff/black). T005 is tagged [P] and nominally parallel with T004, yet its verification implicitly requires a tool no task installs. Add ruff (and black, since [tool.black] is configured) to T004's pinned list or state how the isolated venv obtains it.

T011 is tagged [P] and listed as parallel with T002, but it loads transformers/sentence-transformers models, which requires the repaired requirements.txt from T004 to be installed first. The [P] tag is only safe if dependency installation (T004) is treated as a prior environment-setup step; make this explicit (e.g. note 'T011 [P] after T004') to avoid an implicit ordering requirement hidden behind the parallel tag.
